
Configure a file-backed result cache
CONDA_PRESTO_RESULT_CACHE_BACKEND=file
CONDA_PRESTO_RESULT_CACHE_DIR=<temporary cache directory>

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error --dump-header headers.txt 'http://127.0.0.1:58751/resolve?spec=zlib&channel=conda-forge&platform=linux-64' > result.json

Restart the service with the same cache directory

Retrieve the retained result without another solve

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:58772/r/e08b81e283e9479632911eaa015fa8a6b91160559a98cc53910a0e35e1efa37a > after-restart.json

$ cmp result.json after-restart.json

Retained bytes survive the service restart
